visual.observation: A registration form visibly requests a username, email, password, name, country, mobile phone and other profile details; nearby text states that selected package recipients will be rewarded OneCoin Tokens and that the tokens will be placed into a OneCoin Exchange Account after login.
visual.context: Registration flow with visible package-reward language and account fields.
visual.potential_relevance: The request to submit account and contact information is directly linked on-screen to a promised token reward and placement into an exchange account, a relationship that conditionally merits review.
visual.limitations: The frames do not establish whether the account was submitted, whether tokens were delivered, or whether the exchange account or reward functioned as described.

visual.observation: Package-selection and product pages show prices including 100 EUR, 500 EUR, 1,000 EUR, 3,000 EUR, 5,000 EUR, 12,500 EUR and 18,800 EUR, with listed free tokens, gold coins, BV points and daily OLP points alongside Upgrade buttons.
visual.context: Visible commercial package-promotion and upgrade interface.
visual.potential_relevance: A monetary purchase or upgrade is linked to promised digital tokens, coins, points and ongoing daily accruals, a relationship that conditionally merits review.
visual.limitations: The frames do not show payment completion, the full package terms, actual delivery of listed benefits, or any outcome for purchasers.

visual.observation: A dashboard notice states that payment for an activation or product package is not registered, describes payment processing as normally taking 3–5 working days after payment, asks users who paid to contact customer support with payment documentation, and says that users who have not paid should do so or their account will be deactivated in the next days.
visual.context: Account dashboard notice concerning package activation, payment status and account access.
visual.potential_relevance: A payment request is linked to a stated near-term account-deactivation consequence and, for claimed payers, a support-contact and documentation-submission step.
visual.limitations: The sampled frames do not establish whether any payment was made, whether deactivation occurred, or the exact deadline.

visual.observation: A verification message instructs the user to click a visible verification link and log in with credentials; it is signed by a support team and OneCoin.eu.
visual.context: Verification-message layout with a visible OneCoin.eu-branded destination and credential-login instruction.
visual.potential_relevance: A request to follow a verification destination and enter credentials is tied to a stated OneCoin support identity, a relationship that conditionally merits review.
